threat_event: Ransomware encrypts office endpoints, the SCADA HMI, and the farm data hub during harvest season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No EDR; antivirus alerts unmonitored; flat network; no phishing training; backups exposed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-07 HMI; BP-01; BP-02
existing_controls: MFA on email and cloud console; monthly patching of office endpoints; built-in antivirus
treatment_plan: MSP-managed EDR with after-hours alerting on office endpoints and the HMI (OT-approved agent); segment the pump house (R-022); phishing training; immutable backups (R-003)

threat_event: Attacker uses the integrator's remote access account to reach the SCADA HMI and change pump, pivot, or fertigation settings
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist targeting remote access tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on vendor remote access tool; one shared account; no MFA; no session approval or logging; no contract security terms
existing_controls: Remote tool connects outbound only; HMI has no internet browsing use
treatment_plan: Disable always-on access; farm-approved sessions only through a jump host with named integrator accounts and MFA; session logging; security terms in the integrator agreement

threat_event: Backups are deleted or encrypted along with production so flow history, office files, and the data hub cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup vault in the same cloud account and region with the same administrators; not immutable; never restore-tested; no export of SYS-01 records
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 backup vault; BP-01; BP-06; BP-08
existing_controls: Daily backups of the file share and data hub
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; monthly SYS-01 record export; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Business email compromise diverts a distributor or buying point payment to an attacker's account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment instructions accepted by email; no call-back rule with buyers; no phishing training
existing_controls: MFA on email; bank requires owner approval for new payees
treatment_plan: Written call-back rule for any change to banking details, sent to both buyers; training on payment fraud

threat_event: Fertigation injection rate or duration is changed through the HMI, burning plants, exceeding label or permit limits, or exposing workers
threat_source: Attacker with HMI access (see R-002) or insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMI shared login; no setpoint change alerting; no hard limit on injection pump rate in the PLC logic
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 PR.PS-01; DE.CM-09 (benchmark); SP 800-82r3 5.3.1; N11-R01 used as a voluntary food defense checklist
existing_controls: Fertigation runs only when the Irrigation Technician is on site; chemical tanks locked
treatment_plan: Hard-coded maximum injection rate and run time in the PLC (integrator change); alert on setpoint changes; named HMI accounts

threat_event: Stolen SYS-01 credentials used to change irrigation schedules or delete field records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-01 mobile app does not use single sign-on or MFA; no alerting on schedule changes
existing_controls: Web console behind SSO with MFA
treatment_plan: Enable the vendor's MFA for mobile app sign-in; alert on schedule and setpoint changes; monthly audit log review

threat_event: Overhead freeze protection does not start on a freeze night because the automation, alarm path, or cellular link fails
threat_source: Freeze event combined with automation or carrier failure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Freeze start depends on the SYS-01 alert and cellular pivot link; no independent local temperature alarm; manual procedure not written
existing_controls: Irrigation Technician watches forecasts and starts pumps by hand when worried
treatment_plan: Standalone temperature alarm that calls two phones without internet; freeze-night staffing rule; written manual start procedure tested each November

threat_event: Hurricane damages the pump house, pivots, and headquarters and cuts power and connectivity for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; spare parts and generator for one well only
existing_controls: Crop insurance; one portable generator
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist in the contingency plan: secure pivots, pre-stage generator fuel, export records, cloud copies

threat_event: SYS-01 vendor outage during harvest lasts longer than the process RTOs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency; vendor RTO 8 h exceeds the BP-01 RTO of 6 h
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report on file
treatment_plan: Paper tally cards and manual irrigation procedure; vendor RTO and RPO in the contract at renewal

threat_event: Field tally entries under shared crew logins are wrong or disputed, so H-2A earnings records are unreliable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two generic crew lead logins on harvest tablets; no review of tally edits
existing_controls: Crew leads sign daily paper summaries
treatment_plan: Named crew lead accounts with PINs on tablets; weekly tally edit report reviewed by the Farm Manager

threat_event: Payroll and H-2A files (Social Security, passport, and bank account numbers) are stolen from the shared file library
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: H-2A and personnel files in a library readable by all 10 office and management accounts; no data inventory; no egress monitoring
existing_controls: MFA on the productivity suite; provider encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Restrict the personnel library to the Office and HR Manager and the majority owner; data inventory; alerts on mass download

threat_event: A departed staff member or seasonal worker uses a still-active account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Accounts not removed at departure; no access reviews (3 SYS-01 and 1 identity provider account active about 4 months after the 2025-26 season)
existing_controls: Seasonal workers do not have email accounts
treatment_plan: Same-day removal from an HR departure checklist; access review at the end of each season and quarterly

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unpatched operating system on the SCADA HMI workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HMI not patched since 2024 commissioning; on the flat network; shared login
existing_controls: HMI has no email or browsing use
treatment_plan: Integrator-tested quarterly patching; segment the HMI (R-022); vulnerability scan of OT in a maintenance window

threat_event: Attacker uses default admin passwords on the LoRaWAN gateway or pivot panel modems to alter sensor data or pivot commands
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manufacturer default passwords on the gateway and 2 of 5 pivot modems (found in P07 testing)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 LoRaWAN gateway; SYS-07 pivot panels; BP-01
existing_controls: Modem management interfaces not exposed on the public carrier network (carrier private APN)
treatment_plan: Change default passwords and store them in the password manager; add OT devices to the inventory

threat_event: The PLC program is lost or corrupted and only the integrator holds a copy, prolonging an irrigation outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PLC program backups exist only on the integrator's laptop; no version control
existing_controls: Integrator has a copy
treatment_plan: Farm-held, versioned PLC program and HMI project backups after every change, stored offline and in the backup vault

threat_event: Dealer technicians or an attacker using a dealer account view or export operator location histories and machine data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dealer has standing remote access; operator geolocation retained indefinitely; no data inventory
existing_controls: Dealer is a known local business
treatment_plan: Grant dealer access per service request; set a retention limit for location history; add telematics to the data inventory

threat_event: RTK correction or GNSS signal is lost or degraded during planting or spraying
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single RTK base station and cellular corrections link
existing_controls: Operators can steer manually; displays warn on correction loss
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Farm Manager: residual risk Low; manual steering is an adequate fallback

threat_event: The single fiber internet circuit at headquarters fails in season, cutting SYS-01, alarms, and email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup internet path; pump house and cooler alarms rely on it
existing_controls: Staff phones have cellular data
treatment_plan: Cellular failover on the headquarters firewall

threat_event: A cooler temperature excursion goes unnoticed overnight and packed produce spoils
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alarm service depends on internet; one on-call phone; no tested escalation
existing_controls: Alarm service with text alerts
treatment_plan: Second alarm contact; cellular path for the alarm (with R-018); monthly alarm test

threat_event: A staff member's productivity suite credentials are phished with an adversary-in-the-middle page that also steals the MFA session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing training; push-based MFA without number matching; no sign-in alerting
existing_controls: MFA for all users
treatment_plan: Number matching; sign-in risk alerts; training with Spanish materials

threat_event: Produce Safety records cannot be produced or are found altered during an FDA request or the GAP audit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records only in SYS-01; no export; shared logins weaken attribution; no review of edits
existing_controls: Supervisor review and sign-off of required records
treatment_plan: Monthly record export to the backup vault; named accounts (R-010); records retention rule of at least 2 years

threat_event: Attacker moves from the office network or packing shed Wi-Fi into the pump-house OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat network; no firewall rules between office, Wi-Fi, and OT
existing_controls: Wi-Fi uses a pre-shared key known only to staff
treatment_plan: Separate OT, office, and guest/packing shed networks with firewall rules; OT allowed out only to the data hub and SYS-01

threat_event: A breach at the FMIS vendor exposes or alters the farm's records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Farm relies on vendor controls; no vendor SOC 2 review until 2026
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report (P09)
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review; monthly record export (R-021); incident notice terms at renewal

threat_event: A desktop or tablet with cached personnel or payroll data is stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 office desktops unencrypted; tablets have basic mobile management only
existing_controls: Laptops have full-disk encryption; office locked and alarmed
treatment_plan: Enable full-disk encryption on desktops; require device encryption and remote wipe on tablets

threat_event: Yield model overestimates a crop, so the farm over-requests H-2A workers or over-commits volume to the distributor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model trained mostly outside Florida; no accuracy threshold; estimates used directly in planning
existing_controls: Farm Manager compares estimates with hand counts informally
treatment_plan: Accuracy thresholds and hand-count checks before any labor or sales commitment (see P10)

threat_event: The AI vendor uses farm imagery and yield data to train or benchmark models for other customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot started under click-through terms that allow secondary use
existing_controls: Data is agronomic; no personal data sent
treatment_plan: Negotiated data terms: no secondary use without opt-in; deletion on exit (see P10)

threat_event: Drone imagery captures identifiable workers or neighbors and is kept or shared without need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No imagery handling rule; imagery kept indefinitely
existing_controls: Flights planned over crop blocks only
treatment_plan: Imagery rule: no use for worker monitoring; retain 3 seasons; share only orthomosaics with the AI vendor

threat_event: Card data is stolen at the farm stand
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Terminals left in the stand overnight in season
existing_controls: Processor-managed point-to-point encrypted terminals; no card data on farm systems
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Operations and Technology Manager: residual risk Low; terminals taken inside nightly

threat_event: Online store customer accounts are taken over or the e-commerce vendor is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; outside farm control
existing_controls: Hosted payment page; vendor MFA for the farm's admin accounts
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low; vendor notice duty to the farm under Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report an incident quickly, so containment is late and notice clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident reporting channel; no training; no Spanish-language guidance
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Reporting phone number on badge cards in English and Spanish; covered in training and crew meetings

threat_event: Security work lapses because no one is formally responsible and no risk assessment is kept
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Security lead not designated in writing; no prior risk assessment
existing_controls: 2026 risk assessment completed (this register)
treatment_plan: Written designation; annual risk assessment each July

threat_event: A lightning strike or power surge at the pump house destroys the PLC or a variable-frequency drive
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One spare VFD for three pumps; no spare PLC; surge protection only at the main panel
existing_controls: Surge protection at the main panel; crop insurance
treatment_plan: Surge protection on the PLC and VFD circuits; spare PLC CPU on the shelf; program backup (R-015)
